forbidden_scope: Any Business reassignment (RFC-003 §16.2) or Workspace ownership transfer (§15) HTTP surface
Any Business creation on behalf of a customer other than the acting user's own Customer record
Any member add/role/scope/deactivate/reactivate change (Slice 4B's membership surface is closed and out of scope for this slice)
Any Workspace create/rename/deactivate/reactivate behavior change (Slices 4A/4C are closed and out of scope for this slice)

Any WorkspaceManager, model, enum, event, exception, migration, dependency, environment or database-configuration change — createBusinessInWorkspace() already exists and is fully implemented; this slice only wires an HTTP action to it
Any billing, plan, entitlement, feature-toggle or usage-wallet implementation
Any application change outside the exact allowed implementation paths
Any alternate authorization algorithm, direct model mutation write, repository bypass, automatic later-contract generation or approval
Setting advance_automatically true, changing merge_policy from human_only, or weakening exact-scope or positive-test gates
Using a metered model API, enabling usage credits, merging automatically, force-pushing, pushing to main or tagging
Implementation of any kind before this contract itself is human-reviewed, merged, and paired with a separate authorizing AI-AUTONOMY-STATE.json update
